pages.title: Age of consent: Pat McFadden says changes to law will be discussed after Brand allegations British Broadcasting Corporation British Broadcasting Corporation
pages.description: A woman who alleges she was raped by the jailed comedian when she was 16 is campaigning to see relationships between 16-and 17-year-olds and adults made illegal.
pages.text: Age of consent: Pat McFadden says changes to law will be discussed after Brand allegations Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand case, minister says 22 hours ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Jenna Moon Press Association Brand was jailed this week after being convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault A discussion over a staggered age of consent is to take place, the work and pensions secretary has said, as the government faces calls to change the law following the case against Russell Brand. Speaking to the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg, Pat McFadden said that "appalling" stories of "abuse of power by powerful men" have emerged this week. A woman who alleges she was raped by jailed comedian Brand when she was 16 is now campaigning to see the law changed so that relationships between 16 and 17-year-olds and adults would be illegal. Questions over a staggered age of consent have "been raised and will be discussed" McFadden said, adding: "[I] can't tell you what the conclusion of that would be, but the last week has certainly put that up in lights." Adults of any age are legally able to have sex with 16 and 17-year-olds, under UK law. Mia Latter, who has waived her right to anonymity, told the Sunday Times that she wants the age of consent to be staggered. Latter is one of six women who made allegations against Brand in 2023 as part of a Times, Sunday Times and Channel 4's Dispatches investigation. Brand denied the allegations at the time and none of the six women were complainants in Brand's recent criminal trial. At Southwark Crown Court on Monday, Brand was sentenced to 10-and-a-half-years imprisonment after being convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault, involving four women between 2004 and 2009. He was acquitted of two counts of rape and one allegation of attempted indecent assault. Latter said she was 16 when she met the comedian, then 30. She told the Sunday Times: "I think people were so struck by my story because of the age difference and the clear imbalance [in power]. "I don't want to criminalise teenagers having sex with each other. "If you're between the ages of 16 and 18, it seems reasonable that you can have relationships with each other, and [teenagers] are always going to. "But...if you're in your thirties, forties and fifties and you're trying to have a relationship with someone under the age of 18, it [should be] a criminal offence." Latter told the Sunday Times the CPS decided not to include her as part of Brand's criminal trial but police wanted her to be part of "subsequent" proceedings. She told the paper she was "devastated" by the decision and that police had said they didn't want the trial "to become 'the Alice show'", a reference to her pseudonym in the stories published in 2023. It is understood the Met Police has apologised for the language officers used in a meeting with Latter about her case. A Met spokesperson said: "This investigation remains ongoing. We understand the delay has been distressing for this victim-survivor. However, our focus has been on putting forward the best possible evidence." Layla Stone, founder of the campaign group Close the Consent Gap, said bringing in a staggered age of consent was about addressing a "power imbalance" in relationships involving 16 and 17 year-olds and adults. She urged ministers to commit to such a change. Stone, a child protection social worker, told the BBC that 16 and 17 year-olds were seen as children in "every single framework of the law" and "we don't believe [they are] old enough to consent to having sex with much older adults". pages.text: UNESCO : Building Peace through Education, Science and Culture, communication and information Skip to main content Help Us Improve Your UNESCO Website Experience close Search Search Quick links: AI Response to Crisis Key Challenges ©Ramon R/Shutterstock.com COP31: Protecting our water reserves As COP31 takes place in Antalya, Türkiye (9-20 November 2026) on the theme of water and ocean resilience, UNESCO advocates for integrated solutions combining science, education and Indigenous and local knowledge. With glaciers, ice and snow, which hold nearly 70% of the world’s freshwater, melting rapidly, UNESCO is also releasing a report on how AI shapes our understanding of climate change. Read more UNESCO for the people What does UNESCO #ForThePeople look like? A child learning to read. A journalist reporting safely. Heritage passed on to the next generation. Technology that serves everyone, not just a few. Every day, across the world, ‌UNESCO works to turn these ambitions into reality through education, science, culture and communication. Because our work is ultimately about people and improving lives everywhere. Read more Thumbnail play_arrow ©UNESCO Delivering for people in crisis Culture, education, science, and information are essential needs in times of turbulence and crisis. They are powerful drivers of social cohesion, resilience, and hope in a better future. UNESCO plays a vital role in safeguarding the social and cultural foundations that underpin stability, dignity, and recovery for communities affected by crises. By protecting these pillars, we help ensure that societies can rebuild not only infrastructure, but also trust, identity, and the collective capacity to move forward. Read more ©UNESCO Our impact in communities Discover how UNESCO drives change around the world. The Organization provides key services for its Member States, setting global norms and standards, developing tools for international cooperation, producing knowledge for public policies and building global networks of sites and institutions inscribed on its lists. Discover Thumbnail play_arrow © UNESCO Our fields of expertise UNESCO uses education, science, culture, communication and information to foster mutual understanding and respect for our planet. Our strategic objectives UNESCO's strategy addresses global challenges with goals in education, the environment, social cohesion, and technology. Delivering in times of emergencies UNESCO supports communities affected by conflict and natural disasters, ensuring access to quality education and safeguarding cultural heritage. Building stronger multilateralism UNESCO stands on the frontline of international cooperation, in close coordination with sister agencies of the UN System. Applying or Implementing Particulate Matter (PM) Standards On this page: Designations: How do we know if an area is not meeting the standards? What are state implementation plan (SIP) requirements? How do states develop SIPs and start attaining the standards? Designations: How do we know if an area is not meeting particulate matter (PM) standards? How does EPA help areas maintain PM standards? The Advance Program is a collaborative effort between EPA, states, tribes, and local governments. It encourages expeditious emission reductions primarily in attainment areas to help these areas continue to meet the NAAQS. Burn Wise is a voluntary partnership program between EPA, state agencies, manufacturers, and consumers to emphasize the importance of burning the right wood, the right way, in the right appliance. More programs that help states attain standards. Areas within each state are "designated" as either meeting (attaining) PM standards or not meeting them. In some cases, an entire state may attain a standard. Those areas that exceed the standards are known as “nonattainment areas.” Nonattainment areas for PM and the other criteria air pollutants are listed in the Green Book . The NAAQS designations process Green Book Area Information: PM-2.5 (2012 Standard) Area Information PM-2.5 (2006) Area Information PM-2.5 (1997) Area Information PM-10 (1987) Area Information PM Designations : Information on the process EPA, the states, and the tribes follow to determine whether or not an area is meeting the revised national air quality standards for PM established in 2012, 2006, 1997, and 1987. Along with developing the PM standards themselves (part of the National Ambient Air Quality Standards, or NAAQS ), EPA also develops requirements for how to go about attaining and maintaining those standards: 2012 PM NAAQS Timelines : Learn how implementation of the 2012 standards will develop alongside continued implementation of the 2006 standards. What are state implementation plan (SIP) requirements? Air quality standards get applied, or implemented, through controlling air pollution from emission sources. Each state is required to develop a plan for how they will control air pollution within their jurisdiction. This plan is called a State Implementation Plan (SIP). In general, the SIP consists of programs (air quality monitoring and modeling, and emission inventories and control strategies) and documents (policies and rules) that the state uses to attain and maintain the NAAQS. A state must engage the public, through notices and public hearings, before sending the SIP to EPA for approval. Tribes may develop plans if they choose to do so, otherwise EPA will develop an implementation plan for them. Learn more about SIP requirements, and how EPA works together with states to meet them . Learn more about the NAAQS implementation process SIP Status for each State , including tribal implementation plans (TIPs): EPA evaluates the submitted SIPs, then issues a notice, indicating that either the SIP has been approved or needs additional work. Once the SIP has been approved, the state implements its air pollution control strategies to gradually reduce PM pollution. How do states develop SIPs and start attaining the standards? EPA's checklist guide to preparing a PM SIP : State, local, and tribal air quality agencies can find assistance in developing their plans to implement PM standards. Tools include timeframes for submitting parts of the SIP, and how to use emissions data to demonstrate progress in reducing PM. Skip to global NPS navigation Skip to the main content Skip to the footer section National Park Service Search Search This Site All NPS Exiting nps.gov Cancel Contact Us A Trip Plan is a written plan that captures important details about your travel itinerary and plans while visiting a national park or any outdoor wilderness area. A Trip plan can be shared with Search and Rescue authorities to help them locate you if you don’t return at the end of your activity (e.g. hike) when expected. The Trip Plan can be written/printed on paper or emailed to your “Trusted Contact” before you go on your trip. A Trusted Contact is someone who is not going on the trip with you. You can use our fillable template below or create your own plan to include travel details, expected return date and time, and activity details. Email or share a paper copy of your plan with your Trusted Contact. Click to download this sample Trip Plan Template. The NPS Trip Plan Template is ideal for capturing details of a day-long or overnight trip. If you are planning a longer visit or are traveling with a large group, use multiple pages of the Trip Plan or use your own extra paper. Please note that: A Trip Plan is NOT required to visit a national park. A Trip Plan is NOT required to seek help during an emergency. A Trip Plan is NOT a substitute for required activity permits. If you are visiting a park: Use this sample template or create your own Trip Plan. The more details you provide the more help Search and Rescue authorities will have in the event of an emergency. Leave this form with a Trusted Contact who is not going on the trip Notify the Trusted Contact if you put your Backup Plan in action Notify the Trusted Contact when you complete each activity Do not leave the Trip Plan with the park, they will not accept it If you are a Trusted Contact: You have been selected as the Trusted Contact for a Visitor during their trip. If they do not return from their activity by the expected date and time noted in their Trip Plan: Try contacting the Visitor using the contact number listed in their Trip Plan If you do not hear from them, contact authorities and share with them the information from the Visitor's Trip Plan Disclaimer: The Trip Plan does not guarantee your safety or rescue. It is the visitor's responsibility to accept the risks inherent with their trip and to be self-reliant in the event of an emergency. The Trip Plan relies on the visitor providing correct information to the trusted contact. Search and rescue efforts can be substantially impeded if: Incorrect information is on the Trip Plan The Visitor deviates from their Trip Plan The Trusted Contact does not receive the Trip Plan or The Trusted Contact does not contact authorities. pages.title: Herramienta de carga de documentos del IRS | Internal Revenue Service
pages.description: Usted puede subir información de forma segura con la herramienta de carga de documentación del IRS. Obtenga acceso a través de un aviso del IRS, conversación telefónica o visita en persona.
pages.text: Herramienta de carga de documentos del IRS | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content Herramienta de carga de documentos del IRS English Español Más en Ayuda Asistente tributario interactivo Herramientas Herramienta de carga de documentos Denunciar fraude (en inglés) Estafas tributarias Robo de identidad Avisos y cartas Apelaciones Preguntas Frecuentes (en inglés) Accesibilidad Comuníquese con su oficina local del IRS Comuníquese con una oficina internacional del IRS Temas Tributarios Otros Idiomas (en inglés) Usted puede subir documentos al IRS para responder a un aviso o carta del IRS. También puede solicitar que el aviso o la carta se transcriba a un formato de medios de comunicación alternativos. No presente declaraciones de impuestos mediante esta herramienta; no podemos podemos procesarlas. Lo que usted necesita Un código de acceso (si se le proporciona) o el aviso o el número de la carta o el título Nombre y apellido o nombre del negocio en el aviso o carta Número del Seguro Social (SSN, por sus siglas en ingles), número de identificación personal del contribuyente del IRS (ITIN, por sus siglas en inglés) o número de identificación del empleador (EIN, por sus siglas en ingles) Nota : La conversión a su formato preferido y el envió por correo postal pueden tardar hasta 15 días. Los archivos de gran tamaño pueden tardar más. Los formatos de audio, eBraille y texto sin formato se proporcionarán en una unidad flash. Los formatos en Braille y en letra grande se imprimirán. Utilice la herramienta de carga de documentos (en inglés) Lo que necesita para solicitar un formato de medios de comunicación alternativos mediante esta herramienta El producto tributario, aviso o carta del IRS en formato digital. Los formatos preferidos disponibles son audio (solo para avisos), braille, e-Braile, letra grande o texto sin formato (.txt). Nota: Permita aproximadamente 15 días para que el centro de medios de comunicación alternativos convierta su solicitud al formato que prefiera y se la envié por correo. Los archivos de gran tamaño pueden tardar más. Los archivos de audio, e-Braile y texto sin formato (.txt) se proporcionará en una unidad flash, mientras que los materiales en braille y letra grande se proporcionaran como copias empresas. Para más información consulte accesibilidad. Cómo funciona La Herramienta de Carga de Documentos del IRS es una manera segura, fácil y rápida de enviar información al IRS. Puede utilizar la herramienta para: Cargar documentos escaneados, fotos o copias digitales de documentos como JPG, PNG o PDF Obtener confirmación de que hemos recibido sus documentos Si no tiene un código de acceso Puede introducir el aviso o el número de carta. Si selecciona el aviso o la carta equivocados en el menú desplegable, podrían producirse retrasos. Verifique que sea el IRS Si recibe un aviso con un enlace, compruébelo cuidadosamente. Debe incluir “https” y “irs.gov”. Por ejemplo: https://www.irs.gov/es/individuals/understanding-your-notice-or-letter Relacionado Como entender su carta o aviso del IRS IRS extiende correspondencia digital segura para contribuyentes Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 27-Aug-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print

pages.text: Order of presidential succession | USAGov Skip to main content Order of presidential succession If a U.S. president cannot carry out the duties of the office, the responsibilities are passed to another government leader in a specific order. What happens if the president is no longer able to serve The president of the United States may be replaced if he or she: Becomes incapacitated Dies Resigns Is unable to hold office Is removed from office What determines the presidential order of succession The U.S. Constitution and the Presidential Succession Act of 1947 outline the presidential line of succession. The line of succession of cabinet officers is in the order of their agencies’ creation. Close Sss1031's Diary New mapper looking for feedback on campus edits Posted by Sss1031 on 10 November 2026 in English . Hi everyone! I’m a university student, mapping around campus as part of a class assignment. I’m still learning OSM’s tagging conventions and sourcing norms, so I’d really appreciate any feedback, suggestions, or corrections on my edits and changeset comments. If you review any of my edits, feel free to leave a comment or reply here. Thanks so much for your time and guidance! Discussion Comment from Adrian Shobrooke on 10 November 2026 at 19:33 Linking to your edits may help. Otherwise you’re effectively expecting others to look for them. The edits look pretty good, but I’ve added some thoughts to each edit, in the Discussion area. Well done! Chris UK Comment from calculavalorhoy on 12 November 2026 at 04:10 Welcome to OSM! Campus mapping is a great way to learn — I am new here myself, and starting with the places you know best makes the tagging rules much easier to pick up. Well done on getting your first edits reviewed so quickly. Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

pages.title: Tipos de cáncer | Cáncer | CDC
pages.description: Información básica y estadísticas sobre algunos de los cánceres más comunes.
pages.text: Tipos de cáncer | Cáncer | CDC Ir al contenido del sitio Ir a la búsqueda Un sitio oficial del Gobierno de Estados Unidos Así es como usted puede verificarlo Los sitios web oficiales usan .gov Un sitio web .gov pertenece a una organización oficial del Gobierno de Estados Unidos. Los sitios web seguros .gov usan HTTPS Un candado ( ) o https:// significa que usted se conectó de forma segura a un sitio web .gov. Comparta información sensible sólo en sitios web oficiales y seguros. Tipos de cáncer English (US) Qué necesita saber Los CDC proveen información básica y estadísticas sobre algunos de los cánceres más comunes en los Estados Unidos. Tipos de cáncer Información básica sobre los cánceres de cabeza y cuello Estos cánceres comienzan en la cabeza y la garganta, sin incluir el cerebro ni los ojos. Cáncer colorrectal Si usted tiene 45 años de edad o más, hágase la prueba de detección de cáncer colorrectal. Cáncer de cuello uterino Pruebas de detección y la vacuna contra el VPH pueden ayudar a prevenir el cáncer de cuello uterino. Cánceres ginecológicos Obtenga información sobre los cánceres que se originan en los órganos reproductores de la mujer. Información básica sobre el cáncer de hígado Usted puede disminuir su riesgo de contraer cáncer de hígado de varias maneras. Cáncer de mama Consulte con su médico sobre cuándo y con qué frecuencia se debe hacer una mamografía. Información básica sobre el mesotelioma El mesotelioma se forma en el tejido que recubre varios órganos internos. Información básica sobre el mieloma El mieloma, también llamado mieloma múltiple, es un cáncer de las células plasmáticas. Cáncer de ovario Conozca los síntomas y lo que puede hacer para reducir su riesgo. Cáncer de piel Las personas con ciertas características están en mayor riesgo de tener cáncer de piel. Ground-level Ozone Pollution Announcements 12/20/2024 - EPA releases Volumes 1 and 2 of the Integrated Review Plan for the current review of the Ozone National Ambient Air Quality Standards. 1 Ozone can be “good” or “bad” for health and the environment depending on where it’s found in the atmosphere. Stratospheric ozone is “good” because it protects living things from ultraviolet radiation from the sun. Ground-level ozone, the topic of this website, is “bad” because it can trigger a variety of health problems . EPA regulations help states reduce ozone levels in outdoor air. pages.title: UNESCO : Construire la paix par l'éducation, la science, la culture, la communication et l'information
pages.description: En savoir plus sur le rôle, la vision et les résultats de l'UNESCO. L'UNESCO est l'Organisation des Nations unies pour l'éducation, la science et la culture. Notre objectif est de promouvoir la paix et la sécurité par le biais de la coopération internationale.
pages.text: UNESCO : Construire la paix par l'éducation, la science, la culture, la communication et l'information Aller au contenu principal Aidez-nous à améliorer votre expérience sur le site web de l’UNESCO close Recherche Recherche Accès rapide : Intelligence artificielle Réponse aux urgences Défis majeurs ©Ramon R/Shutterstock.com COP31 : Protéger nos réserves d’eau Alors que la COP31 se tient à Antalya (Türkiye) du 9 au 20 novembre 2026, sur le thème de l’eau et de la résilience des océans, l’UNESCO plaide pour des solutions intégrées associant la science, l’éducation ainsi que les savoirs autochtones et locaux. Alors que les glaciers, la glace et la neige, qui renferment près de 70 % de l’eau douce du monde, fondent à un rythme accéléré, l’UNESCO publie également un rapport sur la manière dont l’IA façonne notre compréhension du changement climatique. En savoir plus L'UNESCO pour les peuples À quoi ressemble l'UNESCO #PourLesPeuples ? Un enfant qui apprend à lire. Un journaliste qui travaille en sécurité. Un patrimoine transmis à la génération suivante. Une technologie qui bénéficie à tous, et pas seulement à quelques-uns. Chaque jour, aux quatre coins du monde, l'UNESCO fait vivre ces ambitions à travers l'éducation, la science, la culture et la communication pour tous les peuples et pour l'amélioration de leurs vies quotidiennes. En savoir plus Thumbnail play_arrow ©UNESCO Répondre aux crises, au service des peuples La culture, l’éducation, les sciences et l’information sont des besoins essentiels en période de turbulence et de crise. Elles constituent de puissants moteurs de cohésion sociale, de résilience et d’espoir en un avenir meilleur. L’UNESCO joue un rôle essentiel dans la sauvegarde des fondements sociaux et culturels qui sous-tendent la stabilité, la dignité et le rétablissement des communautés touchées par les crises. En protégeant ces piliers, nous contribuons à garantir que les sociétés puissent reconstruire non seulement leurs infrastructures, mais aussi la confiance, l’identité et la capacité collective d’aller de l’avant. En savoir plus ©UNESCO Notre impact sur les communautés Découvrez comment l'UNESCO conduit le changement dans le monde. Quatre questions à se poser avant de choisir une technologie pour l’éducation Quelle est l’ampleur des disparités de genre dans le leadership éducatif ? Adapter les écoles malgaches au changement climatique De la promesse à la pratique : comment les enseignants du Kenya s’engagent pour des écoles plus sûres et des apprenants en meilleure santé Voir plus L'UNESCO en bref L'UNESCO est l'organisation des Nations unies qui promeut la coopération dans les domaines de l'éducation, de la science, de la culture et de la communication afin de favoriser la paix dans le monde. L'Organisation fournit des services essentiels à ses États membres, en établissant des normes et des standards mondiaux, en développant des outils pour la coopération internationale, en produisant des connaissances pour les politiques publiques et en construisant des réseaux mondiaux de sites et d'institutions inscrits sur ses listes. Découvrir Thumbnail play_arrow © UNESCO Notre expertise L'UNESCO utilise l'éducation, la science, la culture, la communication et l'information pour favoriser la compréhension mutuelle et le respect de notre planète. Nos objectifs stratégiques La stratégie de l'UNESCO vise à relever les défis mondiaux en se fixant des objectifs dans les domaines de l'éducation, de l'environnement, de la cohésion sociale et de la technologie. Répondre aux crises L’UNESCO soutient les communautés touchées par les conflits et les risques naturels, en garantissant l’accès à une éducation de qualité et la sauvegarde du patrimoine culturel. Construire un multilatéralisme plus fort L'UNESCO est en première ligne de la coopération internationale, en étroite coordination avec les agences sœurs du système des Nations unies. pages.title: Como entender su aviso de la serie CP5071 (SP) | Internal Revenue Service
pages.description: Usted recibió un aviso CP5071, 5071C o CP5071F porque se presentó una declaración de impuestos bajo su número de Seguro Social (SSN) o número de identificación personal del contribuyente del IRS (ITIN). Verifique su declaración para evitar el robo de identidad.
pages.text: Como entender su aviso de la serie CP5071 (SP) | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content Como entender su aviso de la serie CP5071 (SP) English Español Más en Ayuda Asistente tributario interactivo Herramientas Denunciar fraude (en inglés) Estafas tributarias Robo de identidad Avisos y cartas Apelaciones Preguntas Frecuentes (en inglés) Accesibilidad Comuníquese con su oficina local del IRS Comuníquese con una oficina internacional del IRS Temas Tributarios Otros Idiomas (en inglés) Los avisos de la serie CP5071 (SP) incluyen: CP5071 (SP) 5071C (SP) CP5071F (SP) Por qué usted recibió este aviso Una declaración de impuestos de los EE. UU. sobre los ingresos personales, de la serie del Formulario 1040, se presentó bajo su número de Seguro Social (SSN, por sus siglas en inglés) o su número de identificación personal del contribuyente del IRS (ITIN, por sus siglas en inglés). Le enviamos un aviso de la serie CP5071 (SP) porque necesitamos que verifique su identidad y la declaración: Si usted no presentó una declaración : consúltenos. Podría ser víctima de robo de identidad. Si usted presentó una declaración : verifique para que podamos continuar tramitando su declaración. Lo que usted tiene que hacer a continuación Siga las instrucciones de su aviso para verificar su identidad y la declaración de impuestos. Si su aviso le proporciona verificación en línea, puede comenzar en verifique su declaración . Tenga su aviso y sus registros de impuestos disponibles cuando comience el proceso de verificación. Si presentó una declaración – necesitará: The tax return for the tax year listed on the notice la declaración de impuestos correspondiente al año tributario indicado en el aviso. una declaración de impuestos del año anterior (si presentó una y la tiene disponible). documentos de respaldo para cada declaración (W-2, 1099, anexo C, anexo F, etcétera). Si no presentó una declaración – esté preparado para informarnos durante el proceso de verificación. La información de contacto que se indica en su aviso es únicamente para la verificación de la identidad y de la declaración de impuestos. Otra información de la cuenta de impuestos, como el estado del reembolso, puede que no esté disponible a través de ese método de contacto. Cómo proteger su identidad Para evitar que alguien presente una declaración con su SSN o con su ITIN, obtenga un PIN para la protección de la identidad (IP PIN, por sus siglas en inglés) . Si revisa su declaración, usted no necesita completar el Formulario 14039, Declaración Jurada sobre el Robo de Identidad, a menos de que se lo indiquemos. Herramientas de referencia Publicación 1 (SP), Derechos del Contribuyente Centro informativo sobre el robo de identidad PIN para la protección de la identidad (IP PIN, por sus siglas en inglés) Contribuyentes fallecidos y el robo de identidad Lista completa de formularios e instrucciones tributarios (en inglés) ¿Desea ayuda? Puede ser elegible para recibir la ayuda gratuita del Servicio del Defensor del Contribuyente (TAS) . Verifique si reúne los requisitos para recibir la ayuda de una Clínica para contribuyentes de bajos ingresos . Puede solicitar una copia de su aviso o carta en braille o en letra grande (en inglés) . pages.title: Why would anyone want a smart fridge? | Dave Schilling | The Guardian double quotation mark
pages.description: After a hack in France, internet-enabled appliances are looking even less appealing – especially before the holidays
pages.text: Why would anyone want a smart fridge? | Dave Schilling | The Guardian Skip to main content Skip to navigation ‘The only solution is to rip the computers out and go back to the switches, toggles, and tactile buttons that used to maintain our civilization.’ Illustration: Fortunate Joaquin/The Guardian View image in fullscreen ‘The only solution is to rip the computers out and go back to the switches, toggles, and tactile buttons that used to maintain our civilization.’ Illustration: Fortunate Joaquin/The Guardian Opinion Technology Why would anyone want a smart fridge? Dave Schilling After a hack in France, internet-enabled appliances are looking even less appealing – especially before the holidays Sun 15 Nov 2026 09.00 EST Last modified on Sun 15 Nov 2026 16.02 EST Share We are deep into the holiday season now, past Halloween and a mere two weeks away from American Thanksgiving . I’ve already given up taking care of my body, surrendering fully to gluttony, vices, and going to bed at 7pm because it’s pitch black outside. I’ve begun to hibernate like a slothful bear, my blanket and pillow never too far from my grasp. The only thing closer to my hands than my bedsheets is a slice of cold pizza. I just want to eat in peace, thank you very much. Grocery retailers are keen to take advantage of holiday-related binge eating, developing and releasing ever-more-depraved festive novelty foods to subdue us into carb-induced slumber. In the UK, Marks & Spencer is expected to unleash hoards of weird, miniature packages of comical junk, affectionately known as “ picky bits ”, to prevent your digestive system from ever idling into park. “Ham and Barber’s Cheddar Crumpets”. “Twelve Mini Chicken Kyivs”. “British Melton Mowbray pork pie”. These dishes either sound like a thing a tertiary character orders in a Harry Potter novel or the last meal of a 60s British gangster. The French fridge hacks were relatively unsophisticated. An AI-enabled attack would raise the stakes Read more In America, we have Trader Joe’s . There’s no fun name like “picky bits” for the plastic tubs of slop they sell in the refrigerator section. Instead, we turn to our spouses and partners and mumble: “Pick me up some of that crap.” Toffee-flavored cheddar cheese. Pumpkin spice yogurt dip. An advent calendar … for dogs. I don’t begrudge anyone for cramming their shopping carts with intentionally whimsical perishable food products for depressed people. Overeating is a better use of your hibernation time than drunk-driving into an Arby’s at 2am. This is a holiday rite of passage: the junk food gauntlet. It’s as crucial to the festive season as a decorated tree and a surplus of good cheer. But what if I told you that with the press of a button, the entire picky bits industrial complex could collapse before we even have a chance to open our canine advent calendars? In France last month, supermarket refrigerators across the country were shut off remotely by Iranian terrorists . Other European countries have been hit with similar attacks, which occasionally lead to food having to be thrown out. My entire body goes numb thinking about what it would do to US and British citizens if their supermarkets were similarly affected during the holidays. Can I muddle through another family get-together without a large, rapidly-warming bowl of chicken uncured bacon ranch dip to soothe my anxiety? Doubtful. The chaos would be unprecedented. It’d be like Judge Dredd, Blade Runner and The Purge rolled into one, but with worse catering. You might be wondering how someone even hacks a fridge. Well, industrial fridges like the ones hacked in France are operated remotely via computer. It makes some sense that large-scale operations like grocery stores need to have the ability to make temperature changes quickly, without a bunch of fumbling around with knobs and buttons. But internet-connected fridges are available to consumers, too. Refrigerators from brands such as LG and Samsung allow regular peop

pages.text: UNESCO: Construyendo la Paz a través de la Educación, la Ciencia y la Cultura, la comunicación y la información Pasar al contenido principal Búsqueda Búsqueda Quicks links : Inteligencia Artificial Respuestas a emergencias Desafíos clave ©Ramon R/Shutterstock.com COP31: Proteger nuestras reservas de agua Mientras se celebra la COP31 en Antalya (Türkiye), del 9 al 20 de noviembre de 2026, bajo el tema de la resiliencia hídrica y oceánica, la UNESCO llama la atención sobre la criosfera, es decir, las regiones heladas de la Tierra: glaciares, mantos de hielo, nieve, hielo marino y permafrost. Estas reservas heladas contienen casi el 70% del agua dulce del planeta, pero se están derritiendo a un ritmo acelerado. Para protegerlas, la UNESCO promueve soluciones integradas que combinan la ciencia, la educación y los conocimientos de los pueblos indígenas y las comunidades locales. Ver más UNESCO para las personas ¿Cómo se materializa el compromiso de la UNESCO #ForThePeople? En un niño que aprende a leer. En un periodista que puede informar con seguridad. En un patrimonio que se transmite a la siguiente generación. En una tecnología al servicio de todas las personas, y no solo de unas pocas. Cada día, en todo el mundo, la UNESCO trabaja para hacer realidad estas aspiraciones a través de la educación, la cultura y la comunicación. Porque, en última instancia, nuestra labor gira en torno a las personas y a mejorar sus vidas en todas partes. Thumbnail play_arrow ©UNESCO La UNESCO actúa en apoyo de las personas afectadas por crisis La cultura, la educación, la ciencia y la información son necesidades esenciales en tiempos de turbulencia y crisis. Son motores poderosos de cohesión social, resiliencia y esperanza en un futuro mejor. La UNESCO desempeña un papel vital en la protección de los fundamentos sociales y culturales que sustentan la estabilidad, la dignidad y la recuperación de las comunidades afectadas por crisis. Al proteger estos pilares, ayudamos a garantizar que las sociedades puedan reconstruir no solo la infraestructura, sino también la confianza, la identidad y la capacidad colectiva para avanzar. Skip to global NPS navigation Skip to the main content Skip to the footer section National Park Service Search Search This Site All NPS Exiting nps.gov Cancel Contact Us Plan Your Adventure Like a Junior Ranger! Click the booklet to begin exploring What do volcanoes, forts, and rivers have in common? They can all be found in national parks! With over 420 national park units to explore, where will your adventure take you this time? Download and complete the Junior Ranger Park Explorer Booklet to make the most of your visit to a park. The fun activities will help you: Get to know the park so you don’t miss out on iconic landmarks, vistas, and wildlife Pick and prepare for fun activities that everyone can enjoy Learn how to protect the special places that are national parks Use the Booklet to plan every trip to a park. Each time you will learn something new and become a better Park Explorer. Continue reading for a sneak peek to what's inside. Five Tips to #PlanLikeAJuniorRanger: 1. Don’t miss the good stuff Visit the park’s website to learn about all the iconic landmarks, vistas, and wildlife. Start with the “Learn About the Park” page: Does the park have mountains, rivers, sand dunes, or some other feature? Will you visit cool buildings like forts, museums, and monuments? What is the weather like for the days you will visit? What kinds of animals and plants will you see at the park? Are there any closures or active park alerts ? 2. Get ready for your activity From outdoor activities to indoor exhibits, there is something for everyone! Visit the park's “Things to do” page for a full list of fun activities. Pick an activity that can be completed and enjoyed by all your family and friends. Pack the 10 essentials and any other necessary gear like a life jacket, bicycle helmet, and sturdy hiking shoes. 3. Don't pet the fluffy cow Or any animals in the park. Yes, even the cute squirrel. From teeny tiny insects to massive bears and bison, please help protect wildlife. Keep a safe distance, don’t touch, and don’t feed any animal during your visits. 4. Share your Trip Plan Show off your planning skills and tell someone which park you are visiting and the fun activities you will be doing. This information can help Park Rangers help you during an emergency. We’ve made it easy for you with a Trip Plan Template on page 13 inside the Junior Ranger Park Explorer booklet . Share your completed trip plan with a person who is not going to the park with you. They can alert authorities if you do not return from your trip when expected. 5. Get lost in the experience, not the park Anyone can become lost in the outdoors, child or adult. Something can catch your eye and you accidentally leave your family and friends to explore it. Before you know it, you cannot find your group. To avoid becoming lost, know the route of your activity, stay with your group, and take a buddy if you need to leave the group. Lost? It’s ok. Your family and friends are not mad. They are worried and looking for you. Help them find you: Stay put – Stay where you are and listen up for people calling your name Hug a tree – If you do not see a tree around you, your “tree” can be a park bench, lamp post, or a big rock. Make yourself big – Wave your arms to help people see you. If you have a whistle, blow it. If you have a flashlight, flash it. Ready to plan your adventure? Download the Junior Ranger Park Explorer Booklet and earn your next Junior Ranger Badge. Last updated: August 21, 2026 Tools Calendar Site Index

Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn Northern California District Office The BLM’s Northern California District manages about 3.5 million acres of public lands, covering a diverse landscape, ranging from the arid and rugged Great Basin to the fog shrouded forests of the North Coast. The Redding-based district office oversees field offices in Alturas, Arcata, Redding and Susanville and a field station in Cedarville. The district contains two distinct regions. On the east, the Applegate and Eagle Lake field offices oversee vast expanses of public lands in a high desert landscape, including about a million and a half acres in far western Nevada. Small communities depend on public lands for economic benefits, primarily through livestock grazing, and tourism uses ranging from hunting to mountain biking. These lands provide habitat for 14 wild horse herds and special status species, such as greater sage grouse. On the west, the Arcata and Redding field offices manage smaller, scattered blocks of public land with more emphasis on recreation demands from urban areas. Coastal forests have habitat for threatened species. There is high demand for recreation opportunities on coastal public lands and in mountainous inland areas. There is special emphasis on wilderness management and National Conservation Lands, including the King Range National Conservation Area. pages.title: How to Report a Pet Food Complaint | FDA
pages.description: You can report complaints about a pet food product electronically through the Safety Reporting Portal or you can you can visit the SmartHub - Safety Intake Portal - Report a Product Problem (fda.gov) where consumers can obtain electronic assistance with submitting their report.
pages.text: How to Report a Pet Food Complaint | FDA Skip to main content Skip to FDA Search Skip to in this section menu Skip to footer links Home Animal & Veterinary Safety & Health Report a Problem How to Report a Pet Food Complaint Report a Problem In this section Español You can report complaints about a pet food product electronically through the Safety Reporting Portal . Your report to the FDA is important. Thank you for submitting it. The FDA continues to devote time, energy, and resources to monitor reports of illness that could be related to pet foods, to determine their root causes where possible. The FDA will review your report to determine whether any follow-up investigation is possible or needed based on the information provided. A follow-up investigation could include collecting pet food or treats, or seeking a diagnostic sample from your pet for analysis. Even if no testing of pet food products or diagnostic samples is needed, your report will be part of adverse event and product problem surveillance to help prevent future problems. You may choose to have your pet food product tested by a private laboratory, but testing may be costly. The FDA cannot pay for private laboratory testing costs or provide reimbursement for veterinary costs associated with your animal’s illness. Please have as much of the following information available as possible when submitting your complaint: Consumers often transfer dry pet food into other containers for easier handling. If possible, please save the original packaging until the pet food has been consumed. The packaging contains IMPORTANT information often needed to identify the variety of pet food, the manufacturing plant, and the production date. Exact name of the product and product description (as stated on the product label) Type of container (e.g. box, bag, can, pouch, etc.) Product intended to be refrigerated, frozen, or stored at room temperature Lot number - This number is often hard to find and difficult to read. It is stamped onto the product packaging and typically includes a combination of letters and numbers, and is always in close proximity to the best by/before or expiration date (if the product has a best by/before or expiration date). The lot number is very important as it helps us determine the manufacturing plant as well as the production date. Best by, best before or expiration date UPC code (also known as the bar code) Net weight Purchase date and exact location where purchased Results of any laboratory testing performed on the pet food product How the food was stored, prepared, and handled Description of the problem with the product. Examples include: Foul odor, off color Swollen can or pouch, leaking container Foreign object found in the product. If you think your pet has become sick or injured as a result of consuming a pet food product also provide information about your pet, including: Species (dog, cat, rabbit, fish, bird, other) Age, weight, breed, pregnant, spayed/neutered Previous health status of pet Any pre-existing conditions your pet has Whether you give your pet any other foods, treats, dietary supplements or drugs How much of the suspected product your pet normally consumes How much of the “suspect” product was consumed from the package? How much of the product you still have Clinical signs exhibited by your pet (such as vomiting, diarrhea, lethargy) How soon after consuming the product the clinical signs appeared Your veterinarian’s contact information, diagnosis and medical records for your pet Results of any diagnostic laboratory testing performed on your pet How many pets consuming the product exhibited clinical symptoms Whether any pets that consumed the product are not affected Whether your pet spends time outdoors unsupervised Why you suspect the pet food caused the illness Resources Safety Reporting Portal Pet Food Safety Reporting Portal Frequently Asked Questions What Happens When a Problem is Reported? pages.title: Cómo entender su carta 4883(C-SP) | Internal Revenue Service
pages.description: Recibimos una declaración federal de impuestos sobre los ingresos, Formulario de la serie 1040, presentada con su número de Seguro Social (SSN, por sus siglas en inglés) o número de identificación personal del contribuyente (ITIN, por sus siglas en inglés).
pages.text: Cómo entender su carta 4883(C-SP) | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content Cómo entender su carta 4883(C-SP) English Español Más en Ayuda Asistente tributario interactivo Herramientas Denunciar fraude (en inglés) Estafas tributarias Robo de identidad Avisos y cartas Apelaciones Preguntas Frecuentes (en inglés) Accesibilidad Comuníquese con su oficina local del IRS Comuníquese con una oficina internacional del IRS Temas Tributarios Otros Idiomas (en inglés) No presente el Formulario 14039(sp), Declaración Jurada sobre el Robo de Identidad, si recibió la carta 4883 (C-SP) Siga las instrucciones de la carta para proporcionarnos toda la información necesaria. De qué se trata esta carta Recibimos una declaración federal de impuestos sobre los ingresos, Formulario de la serie 1040, presentada con su número de Seguro Social (SSN, por sus siglas en inglés) o número de identificación personal del contribuyente (ITIN, por sus siglas en inglés). Para protegerlo del robo de identidad, necesitamos que verifique su identidad y la declaración de impuestos para que podamos seguir tramitándola. Sino presentó una declaración de impuestos, tiene que hacérnoslo saber. Lo que usted tiene que hacer inmediatamente Llame a la línea directa del Programa de Protección al Contribuyente que se muestra en su carta 4883(C-SP). Tenga disponible TODOS los siguientes cuando llame: La carta 4883(C-SP); La declaración de impuestos del Formulario de la serie 1040 a la que se hace referencia en la carta (los Formularios W-2 y 1099 no son declaraciones de impuestos) Una declaración de impuestos del año anterior, que no sea del año indicado en la carta, si presentó alguna y la tiene disponible (los Formularios W-2 y 1099 no son declaraciones de impuestos) Los documentos de apoyo para la declaración de impuestos de cada año que presentó (por ejemplo, Formulario W-2, Formulario 1099, Anexo C, Anexo F, etcétera.) Si NO presentó una declaración de impuestos: Es posible que alguien haya presentado una declaración de impuestos fraudulenta utilizando su nombre y SSN o ITIN. Si no presentó una declaración de impuestos para el año tributario que se muestra en su carta, infórmenos de inmediato, ya que puede ser víctima de un robo de identidad. Nota: Una tercera persona autorizada puede representarle y llamarnos en su nombre, pero tenemos que tener un Formulario 2848 (SP), Poder Legal y Declaración del Representante PDF , debidamente completado en el archivo de la persona representante. Le recomendamos estar disponible con su persona representante autorizada para ayudar a verificar su identidad. Si desea que otra persona le ayude en la llamada y no ha utilizado un Formulario 2848 (SP), usted y esa persona tienen que llamarnos juntos y usted tiene que participar en la llamada. Si usted actúa como fiduciario de una persona, del patrimonio de una persona descendiente o de un fideicomiso, complete y envíenos el Formulario 56, Aviso sobre la relación fiduciaria (en inglés) PDF . Para obtener más información sobre el Formulario 56, visite la página acerca del Formulario 56 (en inglés) . Nota: La línea directa del Programa de Protección al Contribuyente es ÚNICAMENTE para verificar la identidad y la declaración de impuestos. Ninguna otra información relacionada con los impuestos, incluido el estado del reembolso, está disponible. Preguntas frecuentes ¿Qué sucede si estoy encarcelado? Tiene que coordinar con su funcionario de la cárcel. ¿Qué sucede si no verifico inmediatamente? Hasta que no tengamos noticias suyas, no podemos tramitar su declaración de impuestos, emitir reembolsos ni acreditar ningún pago en exceso a su cuenta. ¿Qué sucede si no puedo verificar por teléfono? Le solicitaremos que programe una cita y lleve los documentos indicados en la parte superior a su oficina local del IRS para verificar en persona. ¿Qué sucede después de que verifique correctamente? Tramitaremos su declaración de impuestos. Puede tomar hasta nueve semanas para recibir su reembolso o acred

pages.text: 常见问题 | 联合国 Skip to main content 常见问题 常见问题解答 问：我想到联合国工作。在哪里可以发送我的简历？ 答：请参阅 就业机会 和 志愿服务 。 问：我可以申请实习吗？ 答：访问 联合国实习门户 获取相关机会。 问：我能否获得联合国的财政资助？ 答：联合国不提供给个人或私营组织财政资助。 问：我该如何帮助联合国的工作？ 答：本组织接受符合其宗旨和活动的 自愿捐款 。 问：我收到一封从一个联合国机构和/或联合国官员的电子邮件。这是否是一个诈骗？ 答：一些电子信息可能不实陈述他们是由联合国发出的，或与联合国有联系。请看 提防诈骗 。 问：我想发电子邮件给秘书长提建议。能否告知他的电子邮件地址？ 答：给秘书长的电子邮件可通过此表格寄出。联合国只讨论 会员国 官方代表提出的提案，而且只能在这些提案正式列入联合国议程并经其会员国投票表决后才讨论。 问：我有一个推动联合国目标的项目。联合国是否对此提供财政，后勤或法律援助？ 答：不提供。作为一个主权国家的组织，其资源只分配给其成员国正式批准的工作方案。 然而，非政府组织有几种方式可参与联合国的活动。请访问以下网站： 全球传播部外联司民间社会股 经济和社会事务部与非政府组织 联合国与非政府组织 问：我的学校有一份关于联合国的作业。我在哪里可以找到更多的信息？ 答：请访问下列网站来查找联合国的一般信息： 联合国概况 、 联合国宪章 、 联合国徽记和旗帜 、 联合国历史 、 联合国小百科 和 青少年天地 。 问：联合国提供奖学金吗？ 答：联合国不提供一般性质的奖学金或交换学生方案。 更多问题 达格·哈马舍尔德图书馆 主要机关 大会 安全理事会 经济及社会理事会 托管理事会 国际法院 秘书处 系统机构 纽约总部 日内瓦办事处 内罗毕办事处 维也纳办事处 联合国系统目录 联合国系统结构图 全球领导团队 联合国新闻中心 资讯服务 紧急信息 举报不当行为 联合国日刊 文件 性别包容性语言指南 数据库 图书馆 联合国电子图书馆 联合国年鉴 书店 出版物出售 地图 媒体核证 经社理事会非政府组织 传播部非政府组织 参观联合国 展览 采购 求职 实习 模拟联合国 档案与记录管理 视听图书馆 联合国卡片 如何向联合国系统捐款 联合国纪事 非洲复兴 2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19） 2026年联合国大会高级别周 重要文件 联合国宪章 世界人权宣言 儿童权利公约 国际法院规约 公约·条约·宪章 宣言·规定·说明 新闻媒体 联合国新闻 新闻稿 每日简报 秘书长发言人 联合国图片 联合国新闻统一馈送 联合国网络电视（UN WebTV） 联合国视听图书馆 社交媒体 联合国要点 联合国进行时 全球议题/活动 日常议题 联合国纪念活动 可持续发展目标 我们的共同议程 未来峰会 未来契约 气候变化 联合国和可持续发展 民主 人权行动呼吁 联合国残疾包容战略 打击种族主义 仇恨言论 LGBTIQ+群体 记者安全 促进法治 难民和移民 全球危机应对小组 联合国反恐行动 恐怖主义受害者 儿童与武装冲突 冲突中性暴力问题 1994年卢旺达种族灭绝 巴勒斯坦问题 非殖民化 联合国和平使者 打击虚假信息 防止性剥削和性虐待 妇女为普天下采取行动 信息完整性 联合国成立80周年 聚焦系列

pages.text: _Hobbit's Diary | Mystic Link Trail sources | OpenStreetMap Select Language Loading... Close _Hobbit's Diary Mystic Link Trail sources Posted by _Hobbit on 8 November 2026 in English . The Mystic Link Trail is a conceptual effort to link together various green spaces to form a route from Ward Reservation in Andover, MA, US down to Boston, ending at the wharf where the Constitution is docked. See the main website for all the details. In its present form, it’s a little over 32 miles long. We have a relation defined in Open Streetmap to gather all the relevant ways, and a downloadable GPX file with mile markers for easy on-device following. Note that there are some areas where bicycles are not permitted, so there will be an alternate relation so riders can bypass some minor sections. If one thinks of the Bay Circuit trail as a big wheel around the Boston metro area, we are kind of a north-to-south spoke. Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

pages.text: ЮНЕСКО: Укрепление мира посредством образования, науки и культуры, коммуникации и информации Перейти к основному содержанию Поиск Поиск Quicks links : AI Response to Crisis Key Challenges ©Ramon R/Shutterstock.com КС-31: защита водных ресурсов На КС-31 в Анталье, Турция (9–20 ноября 2026 года), посвящённой вопросам устойчивости водных ресурсов и океана, ЮНЕСКО подчеркивает важность защиты криосферы — замёрзших регионов Земли, включающих ледники, ледяные щиты, снежный покров, морской лёд и вечную мерзлоту. Криосфера хранит почти 70% мировых ресурсов пресной воды, однако она стремительно тает. ЮНЕСКО выступает за комплексные решения по ее защите, объединяющие научные знания, образование, а также знания коренных народов и местных сообществ. Подробнее ЮНЕСКО помогает людям в условиях кризиса Культура, образование, наука и информация являются базовыми потребностями в периоды потрясений и кризисов. Они служат движущей силой социальной сплоченности, повышения устойчивости и надежды на лучшее будущее. ЮНЕСКО играет важнейшую роль в защите социальных и культурных основ, которые обеспечивают стабильность, достоинство и восстановление сообществ, пострадавших от кризисов. Защищая эти опоры, мы помогаем обществам восстанавливать не только инфраструктуру, но и взаимное доверие, идентичность и общий потенциал для дальнейшего развития. Организация предоставляет ключевые услуги своим государствам-членам, устанавливает глобальные нормы и стандарты, разрабатывает инструменты для международного сотрудничества, формирует знания для общественной политики и создаёт глобальные сети объектов и учреждений, внесённых в её списки. Действуя в чрезвычайных ситуациях ЮНЕСКО поддерживает сообщества, пострадавшие от конфликтов и природных катастроф, обеспечивая доступ к качественному образованию и защищая культурное наследие. pages.title: Russell Brand prison message claiming innocence being investigated, No 10 says British Broadcasting Corporation British Broadcasting Corporation
pages.description: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".
pages.text: Russell Brand prison message claiming innocence being investigated, No 10 says Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says 45 minutes ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Sima Kotecha Senior UK correspondent Reuters Russell Brand (pictured during his trial) delivered a message to followers via his wife Laura A message by Russell Brand to his followers in which he claimed innocence for his sexual offences was "clearly appalling" and is being urgently investigated, Downing Street has said. The comedian is currently serving a 10-and-half-year prison sentence after being convicted of rape and three counts of sexual assault. His wife Laura read out a message from him on their Sunday Service show on YouTube, in which the convicted rapist claimed: "I am not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for." No 10 said it expects action to be taken if Brand is found to have broken prison rules. Justice Secretary Alex Norris said the broadcast of a statement from Russell Brand is "completely unacceptable". In a post on X, Norris wrote: "Prisoners are rightly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims. "This is being urgently investigated, and I expect action to be taken if he is found to have broken the rules." In the couple's podcast, released on Sunday, Laura Brand can be seen sitting on a sofa and is holding a Bible with a candle burning in front of her. Relaying the message from her husband, Laura Brand said the comedian - who is currently being held at HMP Littlehey in Cambridgeshire - called prison staff "strong", "kind" and "dedicated", and asked people to support his "treasured wife and family". She said she had been speaking to him and he "is OK and is praying". Brand has positioned himself as a Christian influencer, and has a large following among believers, including in the US. Asked about the message, the prime minister's official spokesman said: "Prisoners are strictly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims and speaking to the media is only permitted in exceptional circumstances. "Prisoners cannot get around these rules by having someone else publish their comments." Speaking earlier, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told Sky News: "His crimes are heinous and awful. I think it's revolting, by the way, that he shows no remorse today in his comments." "No remorse, no sympathy for the victims. Just disgusting comments," he added. Victims' commissioner for London Andrea Simon said the claims will "certainly retraumatise his victims and other survivors of rape who have to hear it". Speaking on BBC Radio 4's Today programme, she added: "The victims during the sentencing hearing highlighted how his denials and ongoing media fame over two decades had added to their pain and trauma. "The fact survivors are still having to hear this now is really problematic and very concerning that we can't do more to protect them from it." While freedom of expression allows convicted sex offenders such as Brand to profess their innocence, Simon said terms of service of media platforms should regulate "the way in which they get their message out". She added that prison rules should also be reviewed to "bar those convicted of sending messages to be broadcast" unless permission is granted by the prison governor. If Brand is found to have broken prison rules, possible punishments enforceable by prison governors can result in restrictions on social visits or loss of privileges such as access to additional time in the gym or loss of TV. Governors can also impose proportionate restrictions on communications where justified. This could include blocking specific phone numbers, increased monitoring of calls or restricting contact with individuals where necessary to protect victims or maintain prison security. pages.text: Cómo entender su aviso CP12 (SP) (incluidos CP12 (SP), CP12E (SP), CP12F (SP), CP12G (SP), CP12N (SP) y CP12U (SP)) | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content Cómo entender su aviso CP12 (SP) (incluidos CP12 (SP), CP12E (SP), CP12F (SP), CP12G (SP), CP12N (SP) y CP12U (SP)) English Español Más en Ayuda Asistente tributario interactivo Herramientas Denunciar fraude (en inglés) Estafas tributarias Robo de identidad Avisos y cartas Apelaciones Preguntas Frecuentes (en inglés) Accesibilidad Comuníquese con su oficina local del IRS Comuníquese con una oficina internacional del IRS Temas Tributarios Otros Idiomas (en inglés) De lo que se trata este aviso Corregimos uno o más errores en su declaración de impuestos. Como resultado, a usted ahora le corresponde un reembolso o la cantidad original de su reembolso ha cambiado. Lo que usted debe hacer Lea su aviso cuidadosamente para ver qué se cambió en su declaración de impuestos y cómo esos cambios afectaron su reembolso. Si usted está de acuerdo con los cambios que hicimos , no se requiere respuesta. Usted debe recibir un cheque de reembolso en un plazo de 4 a 6 semanas, siempre y cuando no adeude otros impuestos o deudas que estemos obligados a cobrar. Verifique el estado de su reembolso . Usted quizás desee corregir la copia de su declaración de impuestos para sus registros, pero no nos la envié. Si usted no está de acuerdo con los cambios que hicimos , comuníquese con nosotros al número de teléfono que aparece en el aviso para la fecha indicada. Tal vez usted desee Visitar su cuenta en línea para: Acceder a los registros tributarios Consultar su saldo Realizar y ver sus pagos Ver o crear planes de pago Administrar sus preferencias de perfil Ver las autorizaciones de los profesionales de impuestos Obtener más información sobre las opciones de accesibilidad Ver las transcripciones de impuestos Preguntas frecuentes ¿Por qué recibí este aviso? (actualizada el 3 de noviembre de 2025) Emitimos un CP12 cuando corregimos uno o más errores en su declaración de impuestos y: El reembolso es diferente al que usted esperaba, o Usted tiene un reembolso cuando pensó que adeudaba dinero o tenía un saldo igual. ¿Cómo puedo averiguar qué causó el cambio en mi declaración de impuestos? (actualizada el 3 de enero de 2025) Revise la sección “Lo que modificamos en su declaración” de su aviso. Para obtener más información sobre los errores en su declaración, llámenos al número de teléfono que aparece en la sección “Dónde puede encontrar más información" de su aviso. ¿Qué debo hacer si no estoy de acuerdo con los cambios que ustedes realizaron? (actualizada el 3 de noviembre de 2025) Si usted no está en de acuerdo, comuníquese con nosotros para la fecha indicada en su aviso. Llámenos al número de teléfono libre de cargos que se encuentra en la sección “Dónde puede encontrar más información” de su aviso. La manera más rápida de resolver la mayoría de los errores de su declaración es por teléfono. Algunos casos requieren información adicional que usted puede proporcionar verbalmente. Si necesitamos un formulario o documento faltante o corregido, puede enviarnos sus documentos a través de una máquina de fax o un servicio de fax en línea mientras habla por teléfono. Protéjase al enviar datos digitales al entender las políticas de confidencialidad y seguridad del servicio de fax. Revertiremos la mayoría de los cambios que hicimos si hemos reducido el reembolso que usted solicitó en su declaración. No tiene que proporcionar una explicación o documentos adicionales al solicitar la reversión, pero si lo hace podría ayudarnos a resolver su caso de manera más rápida. Si no recibimos la información que respalde su declaración original, podemos remitir su caso para auditoría, en cuyo caso el personal de auditoría se comunicará con usted dentro de seis semanas para explicarle el proceso y sus derechos. Si no se comunica con nosotros para la fecha que aparece en su aviso, usted perderá sus derechos formales de ape

Skip to global NPS navigation Skip to the main content Skip to the footer section National Park Service Search Search This Site All NPS Exiting nps.gov Cancel Contact Us Sunrise drive in Lamar Valley, Yellowstone National Park Jacob W. Frank, NPS National parks provide a unique and memorable driving experience for many visitors. Whether you are enjoying the fall foliage in Blue Ridge Parkway, taking in the breathtaking scenery of Going-to-the-Sun Road in Glacier National Park, or watching the sunrise from Summit Road in Acadia National Park, you should always be aware of your surroundings and drive safely. “Driving safely in our National Parks” means more than just driving the speed limit; it means obeying traffic regulations, wearing seatbelts, and paying attention to the road. Motor vehicle crashes are the leading cause of unintentional fatalities in national parks. Unfortunately, one person dies in a motor vehicle crash every week on National Park Service roadways. Most crashes occur during the daytime in summer months, when parks have the most visitors. To reduce your risks of injury from a motor vehicle crash, keep these important driving tips in mind: Stay Alert, Stay Unhurt Scenic views, wildlife, architectural details, the navigation system, your phone, passengers. These are some of the many things that can distract you while driving on a national park roadway. Keep your eyes and attention focused on the road at all times. One quick glance at a text message or looking too long at the scenery could cost you or someone else’s life! "Texting and driving is not worth the risk. We encourage you to disconnect and enjoy the natural splendor of our national parks.” -- John Hughes, NPS Traffic Safety Coalition Take Your Time, Arrive Alive Don’t be in a rush to get from Point A to Point B when visiting us. Many of our roads are historic and uniquely designed to enhance your experience in the park. The roadway widths are narrower, speed limits are slower, curves may be steep, and common design features you see on other public roads may not be present on national park roads. By taking your time, you’ll be able to enjoy your experience and navigate our unique roads safely. Watch for Wildlife, Watch the Road Seeing wildlife in its natural habitat can be quite awe-inspiring. National parks provide natural and often untouched habitat for rare and endangered native species. Many of these animals are good at hiding along roadsides, and they can decide to cross at any time. It is important to be aware that animals are around, even when you do not see them. Do not feed any animals from your car! It is very unhealthy for an animal to eat “people food” for many reasons. Their digestive systems are not like ours. They may die or become seriously ill if they eat our food. Feeding from your car will also encourage animals to hang out on the sides of roads, which increases the chances for car collisions with animals. The number of motor vehicle crashes in national parks involving wildlife are twice the national average ! Click It or Ticket Buckle up! It’s the law in national parks! Not to mention that wearing a seat belt is the most effective way to prevent serious injury and death. You are 30 times more likely to be ejected from a vehicle during a crash if you are not wearing your seat belt. The driver and passengers need to wear their seat belt at all times. Children must wear a seat belt or be properly buckled into their infant, convertible, or booster seat . Remember, you are the key to protecting yourself and your passengers! Comparta información sensible sólo en sitios web oficiales y seguros. el 26 abril del 2024 English (US) Iniciativas de la División de Prevención y Control del Cáncer Qué necesita saber Las siguientes iniciativas ilustran los enfoques integrales de los CDC para la prevención y el control del cáncer. Cáncer colorrectal A través de las iniciativas para el control y la prevención del cáncer colorrectal, la División de Prevención y Control del Cáncer y sus socios promueven las pruebas de detección del cáncer colorrectal a nivel nacional. La división apoya las iniciativas de educación e investigación, incluida la Screen for Life: Campaña Nacional de Acción contra el Cáncer Colorrectal, así como los estudios científicos diseñados para determinar los obstáculos existentes para la realización de pruebas de detección del cáncer colorrectal. Además, la división proporciona financiamiento a programas estatales para implementar estrategias específicas sobre el cáncer colorrectal identificadas en sus respectivos planes de control del cáncer a través del Programa Nacional de Control Integral del Cáncer de los CDC. Cáncer de pulmón Los CDC están trabajando para prevenir y controlar el cáncer de pulmón mediante: La recolección de datos importantes sobre el diagnóstico y la mortalidad del cáncer de pulmón en los Estados Unidos. El apoyo a programas en estados, tribus y territorios de EE. UU. que luchan por prevenir y controlar el consumo del tabaco y fomentar una dieta saludable. La implementación de intervenciones de salud pública y estrategias para contrarrestar el mercadeo del tabaco a fin de reducir el tabaquismo. Cáncer ginecológico Los CDC están elaborando la campaña Conozca su Cuerpo y el Cancer Ginecológico para incrementar la concientización y el conocimiento de los consumidores, los proveedores de atención médica y los planificadores de los programas de salud, sobre los asuntos de salud y las preocupaciones relacionadas con cinco de los principales tipos de cánceres ginecológicos : cáncer de cuello uterino, ovario, útero, vagina y vulva. Además, los CDC están creando materiales educativos que transmiten el mensaje de que muchos cánceres pueden curarse si se detectan de manera temprana y se tratan adecuadamente. En colaboración con sus socios, los CDC educan a mujeres y profesionales de atención médica sobre los signos y los síntomas de cánceres ginecológicos específicos, las pruebas de detección, los factores de riesgo y las estrategias de prevención. Cáncer de próstata Los CDC conducen investigaciones, mejoran los datos en los registros del cáncer sobre el cáncer de próstata y educan a los hombres sobre las pruebas de detección de cáncer de próstata. Cáncer de piel Los CDC realizan actividades de vigilancia, investigación, educación e intervenciones relacionadas con el cáncer de piel . Los CDC trabajan en conjunto con otras organizaciones asociadas en encuestas nacionales, como el Sistema de Vigilancia de Factores de Riesgo del Comportamiento Juvenil y la Encuesta Nacional de Salud, para evaluar la prevalencia de las conductas de protección contra el sol y las quemaduras. Sobrevivientes de cáncer Los CDC trabajan con sus socios para diseñar e implementar estrategias eficaces que ayuden al número creciente de sobrevivientes de cancer en los Estados Unidos. pages.text: اليونسكو: بناء السلام عبر التعليم والعلم والثقافة والاتصال والمعلومات تجاوز إلى المحتوى الرئيسي البحث البحث Quicks links : AI Response to Crisis Key Challenges ©Ramon R/Shutterstock.com الدورة الحادية والثلاثون لمؤتمر الأطراف: حماية مخزوننا من المياه تُعقد الدورة الحادية والثلاثون لمؤتمر الأطراف في أنطاليا، تركيا (9-20 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر 2026) تحت شعار المياه وقدرة المحيطات على الصمود، وتلفت اليونسكو الانتباه بهذه المناسبة إلى الغلاف الجليدي، أي المناطق المتجمدة على سطح الأرض، بما فيها الكتل الجليدية والصفائح الجليدية والثلوج والجليد البحري والتربة الدائمة التجمد؛ إذ تحتفظ هذه الخزانات المتجمدة بما يقارب 70% من المياه العذبة في العالم، ولكنها تذوب بسرعة. وتدعو اليونسكو إلى تنفيذ حلول متكاملة تجمع بين العلم والتعليم ومعارف الشعوب الأصلية والمعارف المحلية من أجل حماية هذا المخزون. للمزيد تقديم المساعدة إلى الشعوب في حالات الأزمات تعتبر الثقافة والتعليم والعلوم والمعلومات احتياجات أساسية في أوقات الاضطرابات والأزمات، وهي عوامل قوية تدفع إلى تحقيق التماسك الاجتماعي وبناء القدرة على الصمود وتبثُّ الأمل في تحقيق مستقبل أفضل. واليونسكو تضطلع بدور حيوي في صون الأسس الاجتماعية والثقافية التي تدعم استقرار وكرامة وتعافي المجتمعات التي تتعرض لأزمات. ونحن نساعد من خلال حماية هذه الركائز على ضمان أن تتمكَّن المجتمعات ليس من إعادة بناء البنية الأساسية وحسب، وإنما من إعادة بناء الثقة والهوية والقدرة الجماعية على المضي قدماً أيضاً. للمزيد ©UNESCO تأثيرنا في المجتمعات اكتشفوا كيف تُحدث اليونسكو التغيير حول العالم. في أوقات الأزمات، يواصل المعلمون مسيرة التعلّم حين يحوّل الشباب المعرفة إلى عمل: رحلة في التربية الإعلامية والمعلوماتية في جنوب لبنان نقوش العلا: قصص من تاريخ البشرية منقوشة على الحجر صون القصص التي ترويها الجدران: مُرمِّمات شابات يحافظن على التراث الصناعي لمحطة قطار مار مخايل Load more نبذة عن اليونسكو اليونسكو هي منظمة تابعة للأمم المتحدة تعمل على تعزيز التعاون في مجالات التربية والعلم والثقافة والاتصال من أجل تعزيز السلام في جميع أنحاء العالم. تقدم المنظمة خدمات رئيسية لدولها الأعضاء، حيث تحدد المعايير والقواعد العالمية، وتعدُّ أدوات للتعاون الدولي ، وتنتج المعارف لدعم السياسات العامة، وتنشئ شبكات عالمية للمواقع والمؤسسات المدرجة في قوائمها. تعرفوا عليها Thumbnail play_arrow © UNESCO مجالات خبرتنا تستخدم اليونسكو التعليم والعلوم والثقافة والاتصال والمعلومات لتعزيز التفاهم المتبادل والاحترام لكوكبنا. أهدافنا الاستراتيجية تتعامل استراتيجية اليونسكو مع التحديات العالمية من خلال أهداف في مجالات التعليم والبيئة والتماسك الاجتماعي والتكنولوجيا. الاستجابة في أوقات الطوارئ تدعم اليونسكو المجتمعات المتأثرة بالنزاعات والكوارث الطبيعية، مع ضمان الوصول إلى تعليم عالي الجودة وحماية التراث الثقافي. بناء تعاون متعدد الأطراف أقوى تتواجد اليونسكو في طليعة التعاون الدولي، بالتنسيق الوثيق مع وكالات شقيقة في نظام الأمم المتحدة. قوائم وتصنيفات اليونسكو تربط مواقع اليونسكو العالم وتسليط الضوء على أفضل جوانب إنسانيتنا المشتركة. 1273 مواقع pages.title: Barristers must stop using rape myths in trials, justice secretary says British Broadcasting Corporation British Broadcasting Corporation
pages.description: Russell Brand's barrister has been accused of peddling rape myths while defending the comedian.
pages.text: Barristers must stop using rape myths in trials, justice secretary says Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Barristers must stop using rape myths in trials, justice secretary says 5 hours ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google James Gregory Getty Images Alex Norris said the perpetuation of such myths in a court room is "unacceptable" The justice secretary has called for new rules to prevent barristers from using rape myths to defend their clients in the wake of the Russell Brand trial. As first reported by the Times , in a letter to the Bar Standards Board (BSB), Alex Norris said it was "unacceptable" to "perpetuate myths" about victims in court and disciplinary action could be taken against those who do so. In his closing speech, Brand's defence barrister, Ian Winter KC, questioned why his client's accusers had not fought back. The BSB said it had set up an expert group this year to advise on "strengthening standards for barristers", while the Bar Council said defendants had a "right to have evidence tested in court". Russell Brand prison message denying rape 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says Brand was sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison for one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. Winter said to the court "not one of them [Brand's accusers] resisted or screamed or even tried to leave". Winter also asked the jury if they could be sure that out of the "many, many women" Brand had had sex with over a decade, "he raped just three of them". Norris wrote in his letter to the BSB: "[The board] must send a strong signal to the profession on the harm arising from rape myths, and that the perpetuation of such myths within a court room is unacceptable, just as they are unacceptable in our society at large." The charity Rape Crisis says it is "really common for people who experience rape, sexual assault, sexual abuse or other types of sexual violence to find they can't move or speak". The judge presiding over Brand's case was praised by the Criminal Bar Association and campaign groups for comments he made during his sentencing remarks to dispel rape myths. Mr Justice Bennathan told Southwark Crown Court: "Whatever women wear, wherever they go, indeed whatever they drink, they retain the right to say no and to demand justice from the criminal courts when sexual predators like you, Russell Brand, act without their consent." A spokesperson for the BSB said such cases "must be decided on the basis of the evidence and not prejudice", adding: "Any other approach may discourage others from coming forward and adversely affect public confidence in the criminal justice system more widely." Kirsty Brimelow KC, chair of the Bar Council of England and Wales which is part of the group examining the need for further training, said it was important for the BSB to remain "independent of the government". She told BBC Radio 4's Woman's Hour that a "regulatory gap" had not been made clear to her and there were already powers to discipline barristers if breaches of the code of conduct happen. She said training for "vulnerable witnesses" was already undertaken but it could be "problematic" if it was made mandatory. Brimelow said there were currently a lack of barristers defending cases of rape and sexual assault and the possibility of further compulsory training could see more pushed out. "What I wouldn't like to see is publicity around one case to take a life of its own rather than looking at what we already do," she told the BBC. A spokesperson for the Ministry of Justice said the justice secretary was "determined to make protections for victims as strong as possible". "Rape myths have absolutely no place in our courts, giving evidence in cases of this nature is a brave act and can be traumatic for victims: they must never feel as though they are the ones on trial," the spokesperson said. Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn < All Public Input & Actions BLM Eases Seasonal Fire Restrictions in Ukiah, California California Media Contact BLM California BLM_CA_Press@blm.gov BLM Office: Ukiah Field Office November 10, 2026 UKIAH, Calif. – The Bureau of Land Management, in coordination with the U.S. Wildland Fire Service , has eased fire restrictions, effective Friday, Nov. 6, on public lands managed by the Ukiah Field Office. Fire restrictions were initiated on June 5 to curb the wildfire risk. Recreational target shooting in designated areas and campfires are once again allowed on public lands with a valid campfire permit, unless otherwise posted. The easing of fire restrictions applies to public lands managed in Colusa, Glen, Lake, Marin, Mendocino, Napa, Solano, Sonoma, and Yolo counties. Details about the easing of fire restrictions can be viewed in the rescinded fire prevention order . The public is reminded to remain cautious and practice good fire safety to help prevent wildfire such as keeping vehicles off dry grass or brush; carrying a fire extinguisher, shovel and water; and getting a permit for any campfire or use of portable gas stoves. California Campfire Permits are available free online or at BLM, USDA Forest Service and CAL FIRE offices. The statewide Fire Prevention Order remains in place for BLM-managed public lands in California. Recreational target shooters are reminded that hot bullet fragments and exploding targets can spark a wildfire. Tracer round ammunition and incendiary devices are not allowed on BLM-managed public lands. Recreational target shooters are required to pack out all spent shells, brass and targets. More information on safe recreational target shooting is available on the BLM website . The public can visit CAL FIRE’s website to learn how to prevent wildland fires. A map of current restrictions and active fire prevention orders are available online . Fire weather forecasts are available through the National Weather Service . For specific questions, please contact the Ukiah Field Office at (707) 468-4000, BLM_CA_Web_UK@blm.gov . The BLM manages about 245 million acres of public land located primarily in 12 western states, including Alaska, on behalf of the American people. The BLM also administers 700 million acres of sub-surface mineral estate throughout the nation. Our mission is to sustain the health, diversity, and productivity of America’s public lands for the use and enjoyment of present and future generations.
